events.title: Annual Meeting 2026
events.desc: Please join us as we celebrate the arts in our community during our Art Social Hour and Annual Meeting! Stop by anytime between 6:00 - 6:45 PM for GCA's first annual Open House. During this event we will have refreshments, family art activities, and information on the year's upcoming programs. The Board of Directors and Executive Director will also be present to talk with those interested in getting involved with GCA. Information of volunteering and copies of our annual report will be available for anyone interested to take home. Our Annual Meeting will start at 6:45PM during which the executive board will be elected and our annual report will be formally presented.
events.location: Garden City Arts, 318 N. Main, Garden City, KS, KS
